Faq.metaDescription: Find answers to frequently asked questions.
Faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
Faq.subtitle: Find answers to our customers' most common questions.

0.a: We deliver anywhere in Tunisia within 24 to 48 business hours. Orders placed before 2 PM are shipped the same day.

1.a: Yes, shipping is free for all orders over 100 TND. Below this amount, a shipping fee of 7 TND applies.

2.q: How can I track my order?
2.a: You will receive an email with a tracking number once your order is shipped. You can also track your order from your customer account.

3.a: You can cancel your order as long as it hasn't been shipped by contacting us via phone or email.

0.q: What payment methods do you accept?
0.a: We accept cash on delivery, bank transfers, and online credit card payments.

1.a: Absolutely. All our online transactions are protected by 256-bit SSL encryption.

0.a: Yes, 100% of our products are original and sourced directly from authorized distributors of the brands (Castrol, Shell, Total, Mobil, Motul...).

1.q: How do I choose the right oil for my vehicle?
1.a: Use our 'Find My Oil' tool: indicate the vehicle type, number of cylinders, horsepower (CV), and fuel type to get suitable recommendations.

2.a: Yes! Create a professional account from our Pro Space page to benefit from preferential rates and adapted conditions.

0.a: You have 14 days to return an unopened product in its original packaging. Return shipping costs are your responsibility.

1.q: How can I contact customer support?
1.a: You can reach us by phone at +216 29 294 195, by email at specpart@hotmail.com, or via the contact form on our website.

Cgv.metaDescription: Read our terms and conditions of sale.
Cgv.title: Terms and Conditions of Sale

0.title: Article 1 – Purpose
0.content: These general conditions of sale (CGV) govern all transactions carried out on the specpart.tn website. Any order implies unconditional acceptance of these CGV.

1.title: Article 2 – Products
1.content: The products offered for sale are described as accurately as possible. The product photographs are not contractual. specpart is committed to offering only 100% authentic products certified by partner brands.

2.title: Article 3 – Prices
2.content: Prices are given in Tunisian Dinar (DT) including all taxes (TTC). specpart reserves the right to modify its prices at any time, but products will be billed based on the rates in effect at the time of order validation.

3.title: Article 4 – Orders
3.content: The customer places an order on the specpart.tn website. Validating the order implies acceptance of these CGV and constitutes a sales contract. specpart will confirm the order by email.

4.title: Article 5 – Shipping
4.content: Delivery is made to the address indicated during the order. Delivery times are 24 to 48 business hours throughout Tunisia. Delivery is free for all orders over 100 DT.

5.title: Article 6 – Payment
5.content: Payment can be made by: cash on delivery, bank transfer, or online credit card. All online transactions are secure.

6.title: Article 7 – Right of Withdrawal
6.content: In accordance with current legislation, the customer has a period of 14 days from receipt of their order to exercise their right of withdrawal, without having to justify reasons. The product must be returned in its original packaging, unopened and unused.

7.title: Article 8 – Complaints
7.content: For any complaint, the customer can contact customer service by email at specpart@hotmail.com or by phone at +216 29 294 195.
